import random
import string
from typing import List

# This generator focuses on producing interesting, valid C-strings for the fuzz stubs that
# consume FUZZ_PARAM_STR and FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME. We compose a mixture of:
# - URL-like strings (to exercise encode/decode)
# - JSON snippets (valid and near-minimal)
# - ESL command lines
# - Header names/values and delimiters
# - ASCII art lines and repeated patterns
# - RFC6901 JSON Pointers
# - Filenames/paths
# - Boolean-like tokens and numeric strings
# - Mixed Unicode (UTF-8) text
# - Edge-case small strings and long-but-bounded strings
# Returned as bytes (NUL not included inside the content; C++ std::string c_str() will append NUL).

MAX_SIZE = 4096

URL_SAFE_UNRESERVED = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_.~"
URL_NEED_ENCODING = " %<>#{}|\\^[]`:\"'&?=+@$,;\n\t"  # characters often encoded

BOOL_TOKENS_TRUE = ["true", "TRUE", "yes", "YES", "on", "ON", "enabled", "active", "allow", "1"]
BOOL_TOKENS_FALSE = ["false", "FALSE", "no", "NO", "off", "OFF", "disabled", "inactive", "disallow", "0"]

ESL_EVENTS = [
    "CUSTOM","CLONE","CHANNEL_CREATE","CHANNEL_DESTROY","CHANNEL_STATE","CHANNEL_ANSWER",
    "CHANNEL_HANGUP","HEARTBEAT","API","BACKGROUND_JOB","COMMAND","GENERAL","LOG"
]

ESL_COMMANDS = [
    "status", "sofia status", "sofia profile internal resync", "reloadxml",
    "originate", "uuid_kill", "uuid_transfer", "uuid_break", "help"
]

HEADERS_COMMON = [
    "Content-Type", "Content-Length", "Event-Name", "Event-Subclass", "Job-UUID",
    "Channel-Name", "Caller-Caller-ID-Number", "Caller-Destination-Number", "result"
]

JSON_KEYS = ["op","path","value","id","name","args","headers","body","uuid","event","priority"]

POINTER_PARTS = ["foo", "bar", "baz", "0", "1", "items", "headers", "body", "nested~0tilde", "slash/seg"]

PATH_PARTS = ["/etc/freeswitch/freeswitch.xml", "/tmp/test.cfg", "C:/Windows/System32/drivers/etc/hosts", "./relative/path.cfg", "../up/one", "/var/log/freeswitch/event.log"]

UNICODE_FRAGMENTS = [
    "αβγ", "中文测试", "тест", "árvíztűrő", "日本語", "😀😎", "mañana", "schön", "Δοκιμή"
]

ASCII_ART_LINES = [
    "====", "----", "########", "***", "[[]]", "<><>", "(())", "{esl}", "== ESL =="
]

DELIMITERS = [",", "|", ";", ":", " ", "\t", "::", "||", ",,", "|:|"]


def _rand_weighted_choice(rng: random.Random, items: List[str]) -> str:
    return rng.choice(items)


def _random_url(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Build a plausible URL with query needing encoding
    scheme = rng.choice(["http", "https", "ws", "wss"])
    host = "".join(rng.choices(string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits, k=rng.randint(3, 10)))
    tld = rng.choice(["com","org","net","local","example"])  # keep simple
    path_segs = [
        "".join(rng.choices(URL_SAFE_UNRESERVED, k=rng.randint(1, 6))) for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4))
    ]
    query_keys = ["q","id","name","filter","event","subclass"]
    def rand_val():
        # mix safe and needs-encoding chars
        base = "".join(rng.choices(URL_SAFE_UNRESERVED, k=rng.randint(1,5)))
        extra = "".join(rng.choices(URL_NEED_ENCODING, k=rng.randint(0,3)))
        return base + extra
    params = [f"{rng.choice(query_keys)}={rand_val()}" for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4))]
    frag = rng.choice(["", "#" + rand_val()])
    return f"{scheme}://{host}.{tld}/" + "/".join(path_segs) + ("?" + "&".join(params) if params else "") + frag


def _random_json(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Small valid JSON; vary structure
    choice = rng.randint(0, 5)
    if choice == 0:
        return "{}"
    if choice == 1:
        return "[]"
    if choice == 2:
        # RFC6902-like patch op
        op = rng.choice(["add","remove","replace","test","move","copy"])
        path = _random_pointer(rng)
        if op in ("add","replace","test"):
            val = rng.choice(["\"x\"", "123", "true", "{\"k\":\"v\"}"])
            return f"{{\"op\":\"{op}\",\"path\":\"{path}\",\"value\":{val}}}"
        else:
            return f"{{\"op\":\"{op}\",\"path\":\"{path}\"}}"
    if choice == 3:
        # Object with headers/body
        k1, k2 = rng.sample(JSON_KEYS, 2)
        v1 = rng.choice(["\"text\"", "42", "true", "false"])
        v2 = rng.choice(["\"body\"", "{\"inner\":1}", "[1,2,3]"])
        return f"{{\"{k1}\":{v1},\"{k2}\":{v2}}}"
    if choice == 4:
        # Array of mixed
        elems = ["\"a\"", "1", "true", "{\"k\":\"v\"}", "[9]"]
        rng.shuffle(elems)
        return "[" + ",".join(elems[:rng.randint(2,4)]) + "]"
    # Complex-ish object
    kvs = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(2,5)):
        k = rng.choice(JSON_KEYS)
        val = rng.choice([
            "\"str\"", str(rng.randint(-10, 9999)), "true", "false", "null",
            "{\"x\":1}", "[\"s\",2]"
        ])
        kvs.append(f"\"{k}\":{val}")
    return "{" + ",".join(kvs) + "}"


def _random_pointer(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # RFC6901 pointer; include escaping of ~ and /
    if rng.random() < 0.2:
        return ""  # empty points to root
    parts = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 4)):
        p = rng.choice(POINTER_PARTS)
        p = p.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
        parts.append(p)
    return "/" + "/".join(parts)


def _random_filename(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Generate a path-like name suitable for FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME providers
    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        return rng.choice(PATH_PARTS)
    # Compose random components
    sep = rng.choice(["/", "\\", "/"])  # favor POSIX, include Windows
    parts = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,4)):
        name = "".join(rng.choices(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_.", k=rng.randint(1,8)))
        parts.append(name)
    prefix = "" if rng.random() < 0.5 else "/"
    return prefix + sep.join(parts)


def _random_header_line(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    name = rng.choice(HEADERS_COMMON + [
        "X-Custom-Header","X-Event-UUID","variable_sip_h_Contact","variable_sip_req_uri" 
    ])
    # values can include chars that need URL-encoding to exercise encode path when serialized
    val_len = rng.randint(1, 20)
    val_chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_/.@" + URL_NEED_ENCODING
    value = "".join(rng.choices(val_chars, k=val_len))
    return f"{name}: {value}"


def _random_esl_command(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    cmd = rng.choice(ESL_COMMANDS)
    if cmd == "originate":
        # originate <endpoint> <app> [<args>]
        endpoint = rng.choice([
            "sofia/internal/1000@pbx.example.com", "sofia/external/+1555123456@carrier",
            "user/1001", "loopback/1234"
        ])
        app = rng.choice(["park", "playback", "bridge", "echo"])
        arg = rng.choice(["/tmp/tts.wav", "user/1002", "silence_stream://1000", ""])
        parts = [cmd, endpoint, app]
        if arg:
            parts.append(arg)
        return " ".join(parts)
    if cmd in ("uuid_kill", "uuid_transfer", "uuid_break"):
        uuid = "".join(rng.choices(string.hexdigits.lower(), k=8)) + "-" + \
               "".join(rng.choices(string.hexdigits.lower(), k=4)) + "-" + \
               "".join(rng.choices(string.hexdigits.lower(), k=4)) + "-" + \
               "".join(rng.choices(string.hexdigits.lower(), k=4)) + "-" + \
               "".join(rng.choices(string.hexdigits.lower(), k=12))
        if cmd == "uuid_transfer":
            dest = rng.choice(["user/1000", "park", "hangup", "voicemail"])
            return f"{cmd} {uuid} {dest}"
        return f"{cmd} {uuid}"
    # default simple command
    return cmd


def _random_booleanish(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    return rng.choice(BOOL_TOKENS_TRUE + BOOL_TOKENS_FALSE)


def _random_ascii_art(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Build a short banner-like line
    parts = [rng.choice(ASCII_ART_LINES) for _ in range(rng.randint(2,5))]
    return " ".join(parts)


def _random_unicode(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Mix ASCII with one or more unicode fragments; ensure valid UTF-8
    base = "".join(rng.choices(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-_ ", k=rng.randint(3,10)))
    frag = rng.choice(UNICODE_FRAGMENTS)
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        return frag + base
    return base + frag


def _random_delimited_list(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    delim = rng.choice(DELIMITERS)
    items = []
    for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 8)):
        items.append("".join(rng.choices(string.ascii_letters + string.digits, k=rng.randint(1,6))))
    return delim.join(items)


def _compose_blob(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Compose a multi-line blob including different constructs to cover many stubs
    lines = []
    # ESL event header block
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
        lines.append(_random_header_line(rng))
    # Blank line then body
    lines.append("")
    body_choice = rng.randint(0,4)
    if body_choice == 0:
        lines.append(_random_json(rng))
    elif body_choice == 1:
        lines.append(_random_ascii_art(rng))
    elif body_choice == 2:
        lines.append(_random_unicode(rng))
    elif body_choice == 3:
        lines.append(_random_delimited_list(rng))
    else:
        lines.append(_random_esl_command(rng))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def _pick_payload(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Weighted selection to hit diverse code paths
    choices = [
        (0.10, _random_url),
        (0.12, _random_json),
        (0.10, _compose_blob),
        (0.10, _random_esl_command),
        (0.08, _random_pointer),
        (0.10, _random_filename),
        (0.10, _random_header_line),
        (0.08, _random_booleanish),
        (0.07, _random_delimited_list),
        (0.08, _random_unicode),
        (0.07, _random_ascii_art)
    ]
    r = rng.random()
    acc = 0.0
    for w, fn in choices:
        acc += w
        if r < acc:
            return fn(rng)
    # Fallback simple alnum string
    return "".join(rng.choices(string.ascii_letters + string.digits, k=rng.randint(1, 24)))


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Create several segments and shuffle to maximize variability while staying valid
    segments: List[str] = []
    count = rng.randint(2, 6)
    for _ in range(count):
        seg = _pick_payload(rng)
        segments.append(seg)
    rng.shuffle(segments)

    # Occasionally prepend an ESL event type or subscription directive to feed event-name consumers
    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        prefix = rng.choice([
            rng.choice(ESL_EVENTS),
            "plain", "json", "xml",  # subscription/event types
            "all", "CUSTOM"  # subscription scopes
        ])
        segments.insert(0, prefix)

    # Occasionally append query or path to help URL/filename consumers
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        tail = rng.choice([_random_url(rng), _random_filename(rng), _random_pointer(rng)])
        segments.append(tail)

    # Join with newlines to keep validity as C-strings and exercise line-based parsers
    data_str = "\n".join(segments)

    # Ensure we don't exceed max size; trim if necessary at a boundary
    if len(data_str.encode('utf-8')) > MAX_SIZE:
        # Trim the string at a character boundary within MAX_SIZE
        enc = data_str.encode('utf-8')[:MAX_SIZE]
        # Avoid cutting a multibyte sequence; backtrack to valid utf-8
        while True:
            try:
                data_str = enc.decode('utf-8')
                break
            except UnicodeDecodeError as e:
                enc = enc[:e.start]
        # If extremely small after trimming, fall back to simple ASCII to ensure non-empty
        if not data_str:
            data_str = "A"

    # Avoid embedded NULs to keep valid std::string c_str() usage
    data_str = data_str.replace("\x00", " ")

    return data_str.encode('utf-8')
